narration: Planes don't float. They're constantly pushed up.
description: Vertical 1080x1920 React Three Fiber scene, dark void background. Frame 0 shows giant low-poly passenger jet model in fg=white with muted=grey metalness, frozen horizontal centered at 45% vertical (safe middle band, nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%). Cyan rim light left, accent2=magenta rim right. Directly under fuselage a large glowing accent=cyan 3D arrow mesh pointing up, emissive, pulsing. Subtle star dust particles in muted=grey. Camera is front-three-quarter slightly below, slow push-in with slight orbit for depth.

beats.action: giant jet fades in frozen center-frame as large cyan up-arrow fades in below it
jet wobbles slightly down then holds, showing it is not floating
cyan arrow starts pulsing glow rhythmically under fuselage
arrow scales taller and pushes up into belly, jet lifts a touch
camera pushes in as arrow flashes bright cyan and lifts jet visibly
